newsitem.title: USA: API says U.S. crude stocks fell in week.
newsitem.headline: API says U.S. crude stocks fell in week.

text.p: U.S. crude oil stocks held in primary storage fell 2.22 million barrels in the week ended March 21 to 304.48 million barrels from 304.70 million in the prior week, the American Petroleum Institute (API) said Tuesday.
API said that crude stocks excluding PADD 5 (Petroleum Administration for Defense District) rose 1.22 million barrels in the week to 244.12 million barrels from 242.90 million in the previous week.
Distillate stocks fell 1.34 million barrels to 102.01 million barrels from 103.35 million the prior week.
API said PADD 1 distillate stocks fell 1.37 million barrels to 34.49 million barrels from 35.86 million.
It said gasoline production rose 226,000 barrels in the week to 7.35 million bpd from 7.13 million in the prior week.
Gasoline stocks rose 1.12 million barrels in the week to 198.55 million barrels from a revised 197.43 million barrels. Last week's number was revised from 198.17 million.
Percent of stocks capacity rose to 92.7 percent from 90.4 percent.
API said reformulated gasoline stocks (RFG) fell 1.69 million barrels to 34.32 million barrels from 36.01 million barrels in the previous week.
It said crude runs to processing units rose to 14.08 million barrels from 13.72 million barrels.
Residual fuel stocks in the latest week fell to 39.63 million barrels from 40.61 million in the previous week.
Crude oil imports fell to 6.91 million barrels per day from 7.85 million, API said.
